infidelite.q1: Does your partner guard their phone more than they used to?
infidelite.q1a: No, their phone lies around anywhere, screen visible, with no awkwardness.
infidelite.q1b: They keep it on them, but that has always been the case.
infidelite.q1c: For a while now they turn it face down or lock it as soon as I come near.
infidelite.q1d: They've changed their passcode, delete messages and panic if I touch their phone.
infidelite.q2: Have you noticed a change in their schedule or their habits?
infidelite.q2a: No, their timetable is the same as before.
infidelite.q2b: They have the odd unexpected commitment, nothing unusual.
infidelite.q2c: They come home late regularly and the explanations stay vague.
infidelite.q2d: Their schedule has changed completely, with absences that are hard to account for.
infidelite.q3: How would you describe your intimate life over the past few weeks?
infidelite.q3b: Slightly less frequent, but nothing alarming.
infidelite.q3c: They seem physically distant, avoiding contact or affectionate gestures.
infidelite.q3d: Our intimacy has all but disappeared, or on the contrary they've suddenly become far more attentive for no clear reason.
infidelite.q4: Does your partner mention new people in their life?
infidelite.q4a: No, their social circle is the same as before.
infidelite.q4b: They've mentioned a new colleague or acquaintance, quite naturally.
infidelite.q4c: One name keeps coming up, but they play the relationship down when I ask questions.
infidelite.q4d: They talk about someone with visible enthusiasm, then get evasive if I press.
infidelite.q5: Is your partner paying more attention to their appearance than before?
infidelite.q5a: No, nothing has changed on that front.
infidelite.q5b: A little, but it's occasional and could be explained another way.
infidelite.q5c: They've changed their style, wear more perfume or suddenly started exercising.
infidelite.q5d: The change is drastic: new clothes, new fragrance, unusual grooming, especially before going out without me.
infidelite.q6: When you ask about their day, how do they react?
infidelite.q6a: They tell you about their day naturally, in detail or in summary.
infidelite.q6b: They answer briefly but without irritation.
infidelite.q6c: They stay vague and seem annoyed by the questions.
infidelite.q6d: They bristle, change the subject or accuse you of being too nosy.
infidelite.q7: Do you feel your partner is emotionally distant?
infidelite.q7a: No, we stay emotionally connected day to day.
infidelite.q7b: Sometimes, but it matches identifiable periods of stress.
infidelite.q7c: Yes, they seem elsewhere, lost in thought, less involved in our exchanges.
infidelite.q7d: They've become almost indifferent to what I'm going through, as if I were invisible.
infidelite.q8: Does your partner get messages or calls at unusual hours?
infidelite.q8a: No, nothing out of the ordinary.
infidelite.q8b: Occasionally, but they talk about it openly.
infidelite.q8c: Yes, and they move away to answer or cut the conversation short when I'm around.
infidelite.q8d: Notifications have become frequent, they delete them or systematically put their phone on silent.
infidelite.q9: Has your partner changed the way they communicate with you?
infidelite.q9a: No, our conversations are the same as before.
infidelite.q9b: They're a little less talkative, but nothing striking.
infidelite.q9c: They avoid certain subjects and get defensive easily.
infidelite.q9d: They're either very cold or excessively nice for no reason, as if compensating for something.
infidelite.q10: Does your partner compare you to other people?
infidelite.q10c: They make remarks about other people that make me uncomfortable.
infidelite.q10d: They criticise me by openly comparing me to someone else, or insistently praise one particular person.
infidelite.q11: Have you noticed unusual or unexplained spending?
infidelite.q11b: A few surprising purchases, but nothing suspicious.
infidelite.q11c: Amounts disappear without clear explanation, or they've become secretive about their spending.
infidelite.q11d: They've opened a separate account, hide bills or spend on things that fit nothing in our life together.
infidelite.q12: Does your partner get defensive when you bring up faithfulness or trust?
infidelite.q12a: No, we talk about it freely and calmly.
infidelite.q12b: The subject makes them slightly uncomfortable, but they don't shut down.
infidelite.q12c: They change the subject or turn the question back on me.
infidelite.q12d: They react with anger, accuse me of paranoia or flatly refuse to discuss it.
infidelite.q13: Have your friends or family made remarks about your relationship recently?
infidelite.q13c: Several people have asked me whether everything is alright in my relationship.
infidelite.q13d: The people around me have clearly flagged behaviour they find suspicious.
infidelite.q14: Does your partner spend more time on social media than before?
infidelite.q14a: No, their online habits haven't changed.
infidelite.q14b: A little more, but that's in line with the general trend.
infidelite.q14c: Noticeably more, and they hide their screen or use apps I didn't know about.
infidelite.q14d: They've created new accounts, follow suspicious people or regularly delete their history.
infidelite.q15: Does your partner make an effort to spend quality time with you?
infidelite.q15a: Yes, they regularly suggest things for the two of us.
infidelite.q15b: It's less frequent, but when we're together it's enjoyable.
infidelite.q15c: They seem to prefer being elsewhere, our time together is becoming rare.
infidelite.q15d: They systematically refuse or cancel our plans, always with a different excuse.
infidelite.q16: Have you caught your partner lying, even about small things?
infidelite.q16b: One small isolated lie, with no consequence.
infidelite.q16c: Several inconsistencies in their stories, piling up over time.
infidelite.q16d: Blatant lies about their activities, who they see or their schedule.
infidelite.q17: How does your partner react when you voice worries about your relationship?
infidelite.q17a: They listen, reassure me and we discuss it calmly.
infidelite.q17b: They listen but seem a little uncomfortable with the subject.
infidelite.q17c: They play down what I feel or tell me I'm imagining things.
infidelite.q17d: They accuse me of being jealous or controlling, and turn it around to make me feel guilty.
infidelite.q18: Has your partner changed their habits around going out?
infidelite.q18a: No, I broadly know where they go and it's transparent.
infidelite.q18b: A few unplanned outings, but they let me know.
infidelite.q18c: They leave without warning, give vague explanations or change their story.
infidelite.q18d: They're regularly away with no valid reason and react badly if I ask where they were.
infidelite.q19: Do you feel a diffuse tension or unease you can't explain?
infidelite.q19a: No, I feel safe and settled in my relationship.
infidelite.q19b: A slight doubt sometimes, which passes quickly.
infidelite.q19c: Yes, something tells me things aren't right, without my being able to pin it down.
infidelite.q19d: My gut is screaming that something is going on, and the anxiety has become daily.
infidelite.q20: Overall, how would you rate the transparency in your relationship right now?
infidelite.q20a: Excellent, we tell each other almost everything, in a climate of trust.
infidelite.q20b: Fine, even if there are grey areas I don't go into.
infidelite.q20c: Fragile, I feel things are slipping past me and that my partner filters what they tell me.
infidelite.q20d: Almost non-existent, I feel a wall between us and getting honest answers has become a battle.
infidelite.r1_d: Based on your answers, your relationship shows no worrying signs related to infidelity. Communication seems open, transparency is there and your partner isn't showing suspicious behaviour. Your relationship rests on solid foundations of trust.
infidelite.r1_a: Keep cultivating that trust day to day. Small gestures of transparency, open conversations and mutual respect are the best defences against the erosion of the bond. If a doubt ever comes up, raise it directly rather than letting anxiety settle in.
infidelite.r2_t: A few grey areas to keep an eye on
infidelite.r2_d: Some of your answers reveal subtle changes that deserve your attention. This isn't a diagnosis, but weak signals are present: slight distance, small inconsistencies or shifts in behaviour. These can have perfectly ordinary explanations (work stress, tiredness, personal change).
infidelite.r2_a: Before drawing conclusions, open a dialogue with your partner. Say what you feel without accusing: "I've noticed that... and it worries me a little." Most of the time, an honest conversation is enough to clear the doubts. If the situation persists, what is at stake is the level of trust in your relationship, not just a passing doubt.
infidelite.r3_d: Several of your answers point to significant behavioural changes in your partner: emotional distance, secrecy around the phone, shifts in habits, defensive reactions. Taken one by one, each of these can be explained, but their accumulation is a serious signal.
infidelite.r3_a: It's time for a real conversation, not an interrogation, but a sincere exchange about the state of your relationship. Choose a calm moment and express what you feel using "I" ("I feel distant", "I need to understand"). If your partner refuses to talk or denies everything outright, consider professional support (couples therapy) to get out of the deadlock.
infidelite.r4_d: Your answers paint a worrying picture. Many indicators converge: secrecy, distance, lies, drastic changes in behaviour and defensive reactions to your questions. This result doesn't prove infidelity, but it reveals a deep imbalance in your relationship that can't go unanswered.
infidelite.r4_a: What you feel is legitimate, don't let anyone make you doubt your own perception. The next step isn't to play detective, but to lay things out clearly: say what you observe, what you feel and what you need. If dialogue is impossible, see a professional on your own to begin with, so you're supported. Your emotional wellbeing comes first.
